# Avenham Media

> UK web design studio. Avenham Media designs websites, builds brands and runs social media for small businesses and brands across the UK.

- Websites: phone-first design, contact forms, bookings and shops, an admin panel, set up to be found on Google.
- Design: logos, brand kits, colours and fonts, print.
- Social: Instagram, TikTok and Facebook set-up, post templates, content planned every two weeks.
- Optional extra: professional photos of menus, food or products for the website, taken on site.
- Shop: Google tap-to-review cards and NFC business cards, designed and set up for you.
- Prices: Starter £450 (one-off), Business £750 (one-off, includes branding), Growth £50 (social media posts bi-weekly and website updates), Custom (tell us what you need and we give you a fixed quote).
- Contact: avenham.media@gmail.com, Instagram and Facebook @avenham.media.
